rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
The wide ocean spans across your sight, making you lose all 
sense of direction.  As you float above the surface, currents 
crash into you, forcing you to pay attention to the water's 
motion.  Breezes rush past you, spraying you with bits of red
seaweed.
   A small pier lies to the south, where the ocean meets the
coastline.  A city rises high above the pier, where foreign
ships dock and disembark, loading and unloading their wares.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
Here, otters and terns circle, splashing happily into the 
ocean.  You marvel at the schools of fish that streak through 
the ocean as though they were birds sailing in the air.  Gales 
rush past you, pummeling you with spray and bits of flotsam. 
   A small platform rises just above the surface of the water
to the north.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
The wide sea spans across your vision, making you lose all 
sense of direction.  Your nostrils sting as the spray shimmers 
you, bringing tears of pain to your eyes, and clouding over the
small raised platform that rises over the water to the north.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating without direction on the surface of the water. 
You marvel at the schools of sharks that streak through the water 
as though they were birds coasting in the air.
   To the north a raised platform rises from the ocean surface,
offer a chance to land and put your feet under something solid.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the listless surface of the water.  As 
you venture across the water's surface, you note your shadow 
below, waving with the waves.  Gusts rush past you, blasting you 
with foam and bits of driftwood.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
Here, otters and terns float, splashing intentionally into the 
sea.  As you float across the sea's surface, you note your shadow 
below, fading and distorting with the waves and eddies.
   The ocean continues to all horizons.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
The wide sea spans across your sight to the north, east, and west,
momentarily disorienting you.  Your ears sting as the mist whips into
into you, bringing tears of pain to your eyes, and blurring the rocky
coast to the south.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
Here, whales and sea lions sail, splashing purposely into the 
sea.  Your ears sting as the spray highlights you, bringing tears 
of pain to your eyes.  In the distance, you can see the foam of a 
broken ocean eddies and waves smash into the rocky southern coast.
The force of the gales and the waves prevent you from any kind of
safe landing to the south.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
Here, otters and gulls float, splashing purposely into the 
ocean.  As you float above the surface, currents crash into you, 
forcing you to pay attention to the water's motion.  In the 
distance to the south, you can see great waves smashing against
a rocky, sheer cliff that appears impossible to dock with.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
Here, otters and terns circle, splashing happily into the 
ocean.  You marvel at the schools of perch that streak through
the ocean as though they were birds sailing in the air.  Gales 
rush past you, pummeling you with spray and bits of flotsam. 
   To the south a rocky coast emerges, boasting a small city
that rises high on top of it.  The coastline appears to be 
dangerous, and impossible to dock upon, however, especially
from the height of the crashing waves.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the listless surface of the water.  You 
marvel at the schools of salmon that streak through the sea as 
though they were birds coasting in the air.  Gales rush past you, 
spraying you with wavecrests and bits of seamoss. 
   A rocky coastline lies to the south, upon which a small city
has been built.  There appears to be no place to dock, however,
as the waves are powerful and the winds extremely dangerous that
close to the coast.

rooms.name: A Rocky Coast
rooms.desc:
Here, otters and terns sail, splashing happily into the water.  
As you voyage across the ocean's surface, you note your image 
below, fading with the currents.  Gales rush past you, blasting 
you with mist and bits of kelp. 
   A small dock lies to the west, jutting out from the abrupt
coastline that stretches along the southern horizon.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating without direction on the surface of the water. 
You marvel at the schools of bluefish that streak through the
ocean as though they were birds sailing in the air.  In the 
distance, you can see the foam of a broken ocean currents.
